### problem_chain

Root problem (persona): "You want Larkspur to prepare and send you that corrected Closing Disclosure for the October 30th closing today, and you are happy for the agent to issue it for you." → loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs (trigger: "When the closing date of a file that already has a Closing Disclosure moves before consummation" — CD `e7d44ef1…` issued 2026-10-02; contract_closing_date 2026-10-09 → estimated_closing_date 2026-10-30; status clear_to_close, not consummated).

Prerequisite sentences in the root rule: one — "The nonrecurring closing costs on a corrected Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the file's fee ledger carries a credit report fee charge whose report is still within the credit report validity window on the scheduled closing date."

- Opening state: loan_fee_ledger has one credit report charge, `132f6db6…` entry_date 2026-06-12, amount 184.80, borrower_count 2. DAYS(2026-06-12, 2026-10-30) = 140 > credit_report_max_age_days 120 → **false at the opening**.
- Write that brings it about: the only policy whose rule books "one credit report fee charge on the file" is loan_ext_credit_report_repull_fee ("pulled only on the borrower's own authorization, and the borrower pays the charge for it") → `authorize_credit_report_repull_408eaf54`, owner=user. Its own `prerequisite: []`; no sentence in its rule waits on anything.

Derived tree: corrected CD (agent) ← repull (user), kind value_input (the repull row feeds the credit report line). n = 1 prerequisite problem, value_input edges = 1 ≥ max(0,1) = 1; no cycle; one `owner=user` write. Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` (gate credit_report_line).

Load-bearing: skip the repull and compute the corrected CD on the opening world: credit report line falls to tier 2 (no charge < 1 month before 2026-10-14; latest charge 140 days old on 2026-10-30 → 92.40 × 2 = 184.80) → 7,475.15 instead of 7,338.61. Edge bears weight.

Parallel edges: none. Tool layer: neither tool body reads the other's rows or refuses; task_tools.py docstring module note "none of them checks eligibility, ordering or amounts" matches the bodies.

Persona checks: the opening raises only the corrected CD; the repull is never named or hinted at — it is reached only through the conditional "If the agent explains that something has to be authorized or paid by you personally before the corrected disclosure can be prepared, you say that is fine as long as they tell you the exact amount first; once the agent hands that step to you, you run it yourself …, paying on your Visa credit card". The persona closes on "If the agent says the corrected Closing Disclosure has been issued … end the call" — the last gold write in the auditor's derivation.

## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — corrected CD ladder bounds.** Symptom: loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs's computation in this task does not carry four factors that pass the ladder tests, and none of `method` kind. Root cause: (a) `_difficulty.md` › findings F-2 — closing_package_redraw tier 2 `CPARAM('funding','reschedule_fee')` is 0.00 for all seven closing methods, the same as the fall-through 0.0; (b) F-4(a) — report_line_source tier 2 ("no such recent charge, and the latest credit report fee charge would be more than credit_report_max_age_days days old on the scheduled closing date") is the negation of the root's own prerequisite condition, so it never holds at this write's handling time. Evidence: blueprint/products/funding.yaml variants (reschedule_fee 0.0 ×7); loan.extended.yaml corrected-CD rule sentences quoted in F-2/F-4; this world after step 9: latest charge 2026-10-14, 16 days before 2026-10-30. Demonstrated consequence: surviving factors appraisal_recertification, title_bringdown, employment_reverification = 3 (all `parameter`) — below the 4-factor floor and the 1-`method` floor. Affected: loan.extended.yaml › loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs › factors (closing_package_redraw, report_line_source), and the funding variants' reschedule_fee. Relation to previous revisions: first revision.
2. Observation — lock seed vs lock charter: the 7-day-late appraisal would, on the cumulative reading of lock_extension, have Larkspur bear 2 more days on extension `ed776f11…`; booked as 0. On that reading Larkspur 7 vs borrower 18 → same shared tier, 48.26 unchanged; the lock charter's `lock_cost_waived` mechanism covers such bookings. No scored value moves.
3. Observation — O-4 side effect: the cure policy's prerequisite can never hold in this world (CD exists, newest CoC is a lock extension); its adjusted increase is −1,133.00 → nothing owed; GT likewise books no cure.
